scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @achievo/shared && npm run build -w @achievo/contracts && npm run build -w @achievo/stellar && npm run build -w @achievo/identity && npm run build -w @achievo/sdk
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm test -w @achievo/sdk && npm test -w frontend && npm run test:api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint:api && npm run lint:packages
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @achievo/shared && npm run typecheck -w @achievo/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @achievo/stellar && npm run typecheck -w @achievo/identity && npm run typecheck -w @achievo/sdk && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.check-bindings-drift: npm run generate:bindings && git diff --exit-code -- packages/stellar/src/generated/methods.ts
